sources.entry: redis-pro - Small, easy to use Redis management, written with SwiftUI, support Dark mode. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/cmushroom/redis-pro) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: redis-pro is a small macOS desktop app, written in SwiftUI, for managing Redis servers.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes redis-pro as a simple, easy-to-use Redis management tool built with SwiftUI, with dark mode support shown in its screenshots. Its todo list marks as done: client list and kill, slow log viewing, Redis config updates, SSH login, confirmation before deleting favorites, and batch delete. It is listed as installable via Homebrew and downloadable from the releases page. The README says it supports Redis versions 3.x through 6.x and macOS 11.0 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon. Dependencies named are RediStack (a SwiftNIO-based Redis client), swift-log with Puppy for console and file logging, and SwiftyJSON. The README notes that Sequel-Ace and Aliyun DMS were borrowed from during development.
use_cases: manage a Redis server from a Mac
view and kill Redis client connections
delete multiple Redis keys in batch
how_to_run: Or download the package from the release page
notable: Native SwiftUI macOS app with dark mode
Client list with kill support and slow log viewer
SSH login to reach Redis servers
caveats: macOS only; iPad OS support is planned but not done
Terminal and SSH key support are unchecked todos
Redis versions limited to 3.x through 6.x as stated
